We need to fix compilation errors. The errors are due to missing Mockito imports. In this environment, likely we cannot use Mockito. We can remove mocking and use simple stubs or avoid mocking entirely. The tests rely on mocking URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory. Could we create real instances? Perhaps ValidationContext constructor expects those. Let's inspect library: com.networknt.schema.ValidationContext likely has a constructor taking those arguments. We could pass null for factories and meta schema, and schemaFactory. The tests only use validationContext to create JsonSchema.from. The meta schema getId is used in setup. We can avoid mocking by creating a simple JsonMetaSchema implementation or use existing default meta schema. There is class JsonMetaSchema? In library, there is JsonMetaSchema class with static method getV7() etc. Could use JsonMetaSchema.getV7(). That returns a JsonMetaSchema instance with getId method.

Thus we can replace mocks with actual instances.

Simplify: remove @Mock fields, remove MockitoExtension, remove imports. Use real objects.

Implementation: private ValidationContext validationContext; private JsonSchema jsonSchema;

In @BeforeEach, create metaSchema = JsonMetaSchema.getV7(); schemaFactory = new JsonSchemaFactory(); uriFactory = new URIFactory(); urnFactory = new URNFactory(); Not sure constructors. URIFactory maybe interface; there is class URIFactory? Might be default implementation: new URIFactory(); same for URNFactory. If not, we can pass null.

Simplify: ValidationContext validationContext = new ValidationContext(null, null, JsonMetaSchema.getV7(), new JsonSchemaFactory(), new SchemaValidatorsConfig());

Thus we avoid mocks.

Also remove afterEach duplicate resets.

Also remove imports for Mockito.

Remove usage of when(...). So delete those lines.

Also remove mockValidator creation: use mock(JsonValidator.class) - we can create a simple stub class implementing JsonValidator. Could define an inner class DummyValidator implements JsonValidator { public Set<ValidationMessage> validate(JsonNode node) { return Collections.emptySet(); } public void initialize(JsonNode node) {} public String getSchemaPath() { return ""; } } But we just need an instance to inject via reflection. Could use a lambda? JsonValidator is interface; we can use new JsonValidator() { ... }.

Thus replace mockValidator = mock(JsonValidator.class); with JsonValidator mockValidator = new JsonValidator() { @Override public Set<ValidationMessage> validate(JsonNode node) { return Collections.emptySet(); } @Override public void initialize(JsonNode node) {} @Override public String getSchemaPath() { return ""; } };

Need import Set, Collections.

Also remove static import of Mockito.*.
